productionBaselineEvidence: Source baseline at initial branch point: GitHub main 5efb99435243a4bcaeff27fc8d41d58b6a9969c2. Prior official AdMob month-open snapshot from Nov 8 verified in repo scope records: estimated gross ₱8.64, 16 qualified accounts / 702 QMP, 30% provisionally designated pool; NOT a current daily revenue figure. Existing BUKLOD AdMob native surfaces, 2-action interstitial lock, consent/viewport gating and 2026-11-07 ad restoration scope were inspected. Production EAS env density variables, compiled release, Android visual fill and live OTA fingerprint are NOT verified.
chosenApproach: Reuse central Android platform-specific feed cadence and existing NativeAd/first-view components. Increase organic spacing only to bounded high-traffic values; add one extra mid native opportunity on high-traffic dashboards, footer banners where absent, Connect inbox row-native ad, and Reels nearby preload. Tighten Reels consent and passive route gating so additional requests honor the same controls. No backend or native dependency modification.
selectionRationale: AdMob eCPM does not justify hundreds of forced ads per user. Maximize real viewable opportunities with media native and placement diversity rather than unsafe every-action interstitials, direct sponsor sales or synthetic impressions. Reusing tested inventory minimizes RC native compatibility risk and preserves publisher controls.
alternativeApproaches: New direct-sponsorship checkout/ads platform: rejected by product owner and requires independent payments and accounting
Interstitial after every tap, back, comment, or swipe: rejected by Google AdMob and Play disruptive ads guidance; risks fill and publisher account
New ad SDK with custom native video player: rejected due APK/native rebuild and increased media stability regression risk
Reuse existing native inventory and add bounded in-feed/dashboard opportunities under consent and kill-switches: selected
